Olde Salem Brewery Ride

Salem, VA · Road

No-drop

Olde Salem Brewery Ride is a road group ride in Salem, VA. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Olde Salem Brewery (back parking lot). About 21 miles, a and B groups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a and B groups. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Olde Salem Brewery Ride group ride

A 21-mile loop around Salem with about 1,200 feet of climbing and a three-mile descent down the back of Harborwood. Splits into A and B groups. No drop. Ends at the brewery.
